thesis: The page is a roof section drawn over the homeowner's own rafters: nothing gets bolted until the rafter under it is found, so every section snaps a chalk line, locates its rafter, and only then drops its flashed mount.

signature.name: Snap Line + Flashed Mount
signature.summary: A graphite rule with rafter-section ticks at 24-in on-centre rhythm; a blue chalk line snaps along it and an L-foot mount (flashing plate, bracket, lag, yellow washer) drops onto the found rafter. Hero: along the 5/12 diagonal with a pitch triangle. Install story: 9 rafters bolt one by one with a 01-09 counter. Mount detail: the primitive zoomed into an exploded section that assembles on scroll. Proof: review cards hang from mounts on a shared rafter row. Prices: ranges drawn between two rail clamps. Footer: mirrored roof face with all 9 mounts bolted.

palette.family: Comp Slate + Morning Paper + Snap-Line Blue + Sun Yellow

layoutMoves: tool-first hero: roof-ready quiz card under the h1, photo clipped to a 5/12 roof plane top-right with the rafter row on its eave line
sticky 9-rafter strip over a two-column step list (text left, what-you-see-that-day right)
exploded mount section drawing with hotspots beside the guarantee
review cards hung from a shared rafter row at staggered heights
price rows as rails between clamps

motion.intro: Diagonal draws eave to ridge, rafter ticks pop along it, chalk line snaps, hero mount drops (1.1 s, skippable, text readable at once).
stories: bolt: each install step snaps and bolts rafter n of 9, counter 01-09
stack: exploded L-foot mount assembles part by part on scroll
motion.hover: 2px snap-line-blue chalk underline grows scaleX 0-1 from left, 200ms
